feel: Variables and classes exist, which is more than many builders give you. But using a variable means typing var(--brand) by hand: the colour picker and the fields never offer them.
Border colour silently ignored var(--line); the status bar later said '4 incidents' — the editor itself refused its own change.
Turning an element's look into a class is manual: apply an empty class, re-enter every value on it, then reset the element. I expected 'extract to class'.
The variables list grew under the Layers panel; my clicks hit the Layers header and the panel came loose as a floating window I can neither move, close nor dock. It covers the canvas.
Every layer name is in Portuguese (Marina built it), so my export will have Portuguese class names.
wish: Autocomplete variables in every field (type '--' or pick from a swatch list).
'Extract to class' from an element, and 'rename all similar'.
Name layers in the project's language, or let me rename in bulk.

deadEnds.outcome: none; manual re-entry + Reset every value

deadEnds.what: dock or move the floating Layers
deadEnds.tried: drag title, drag button, header icons
deadEnds.outcome: impossible; selected through the floating list instead

issues.what: Border colour with var(--…) on a class writes the shorthand border-color; the validator refuses the commit (InvalidStateError, incident) and the person sees nothing

The Styles sidebar view does not scroll its own content: the variables list runs under the Layers panel; clicks there close/reopen/float Layers, and the floating Layers window cannot be moved, closed or docked
Variables are not offered anywhere (colour picker, fields): only typing var(--name) works
No 'extract to class' / 'move styles to class': a class starts empty and the element keeps its styles
Command bar finds nothing for 'class'; its backdrop hides the whole editor
Layer names (and so export class names) are fixed in the language of whoever inserted the element
In class mode, sections with only inherited values are collapsed to a summary

notes: 10 variables (5 colours, 6 sizes... space-8..64) and class .card on 3 cards; featured card keeps own styles (modifier). The Layers panel ended floating and stuck over the canvas for the rest of the session.
instrumentGap: The page reloaded (cause not found) just before end: the probe log (messages, latency, console errors) and the test-port history were lost. The 4 incidents were read from the test port during the task (style.setBorder InvalidStateError, twice: invariant + error each).
